POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Sneha Rao | Age: 37
Body Temperature at Scene: 24.2°C | Ambient Temperature: 30.6°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 6.6 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  2. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): GHB

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
